integrity: An all-n combinatorial proof is provided. The independent standalone path-enumeration program checks all edge assignments for n=2,3,4 and samples for n=5..8; finite tests are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for named red/blue edge assignments on K_2 Cartesian K_n (n>=2), without properness constraints; no arbitrary-product or multi-path classification. Historical priority provisional because the full motivating 2026 preprint was not accessible.
title: A full two-colour rainbow-connection enumerator for clique prisms
